bullets.text: Samsung Expands Refurbished Program - **Samsung** brings its Certified Re-Newed program to the **UK**, France, and Germany.
Apple's Creator Studio Launch - **Apple** introduces a new subscription bundle for creative apps at $12.99/month.
Deepgram Raises $130M - **Deepgram** secures $130 million in funding, reaching a $1.3 billion valuation.
Google's AI Shopping Protocol Controversy - A consumer watchdog warns about **Google**'s new AI shopping features.
Meta Cuts VR Studios - **Meta** closes three VR studios amid layoffs in its Reality Labs division.
Microsoft's New Data Centers - **Microsoft** announces new data centers while promising not to raise local electricity bills.
Slackbot Transforms into AI Agent - **Slackbot** evolves into an AI agent, enhancing productivity within the platform.
Robotaxi Legislation in New York - New York Governor proposes legislation to legalize robotaxis outside NYC.
ElevenLabs Surpasses $330M ARR - **ElevenLabs** reports crossing $330 million in annual recurring revenue.
AI in Healthcare Debate - Doctors express concerns over AI chatbots providing medical advice.
